A tall metal electrical transmission tower stands near the center of the agricultural area.
A small, single-story building with a grey roof is located on the left side, adjacent to a paved road.
A distinct blue tarp covers a pile of material near the small building and some trees.

perception.description: The images show an agricultural plot adjacent to industrial buildings. A small grey building sits near a road, next to a large pile of debris or soil covered by a blue tarp. The crop view confirms the tarp's texture and the presence of scattered white objects on the ground nearby.
evidence_visible: A large, irregular blue tarp covers a mound of earth or debris.
The tarp is surrounded by green vegetation, trees, and a paved road.
White, rectangular objects are scattered on the ground near the tarp and trees.
The ground appears to be a mix of dirt, gravel, and grass.
A concrete wall or fence segment is visible on the right edge of the crop.
unclear: The specific contents of the pile under the blue tarp.
The identity of the white objects scattered on the ground.
The exact nature of the small building (residential, storage, etc.).
Whether the blue tarp is covering waste, construction materials, or harvested crops.
